text:
You need a 3D artist who can take AI-generated 3D assets and refine them into polished, production-ready models that match both the creative vision and the technical requirements of the final product.

I’m Noor Halden, and while my background is in machine learning rather than 3D art, I’m very comfortable working in fast-moving AI workflows, collaborating closely with technical teams, and iterating on outputs until they’re ready for use. Over 6 years, I’ve worked with Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning systems built to improve quality, consistency, and usefulness in real products.

On the product recommendations project for Tidewater Outfitters, I built similar items and you-may-also-like carousels trained on 1.2M interactions and cached in Redis. The result was a +14% click-through rate in a 4-week A/B test. That work required careful tuning, fast iteration, and attention to how model output needs to fit into a live product experience.

On the telecom churn prediction project, I built a monthly churn score for 380k subscribers with per-customer SHAP reasons the retention team could read. That model reached 0.84 AUC on a held-out quarter and 3.1x top-decile lift. The key part of that project was translating model output into something useful for a team that needed both accuracy and clarity.

For your role, I’d bring the same mindset: close collaboration with the CTO, quick feedback loops, and a focus on making AI output reliable, usable, and aligned with product goals. I’m comfortable working through technical details, quality checks, and iterative refinement, and I’d be excited to help develop new tools and techniques around GenieLabs’ technology.

If helpful, I’d be glad to discuss how I can contribute to the last-mile refinement process and support your team’s workflow.
